facts.fact: 朗读会前两小时 Max 紧张到出去「散步」——Sienna 一眼看穿，替她守住场内。
facts.anchor: You’re shitting bricks right now, huh?

facts.fact: 果园是她和 Milo 少年时的避难所——毯子铺树下躺几小时，现实暂时追不上来。
facts.anchor: Milo and I used to come here whenever we needed to escape

facts.fact: Amber 守在果园外，假意搭车送她回 B&B——上车后翻脸指控：我知道是你杀了 Brooke。
facts.anchor: I thought it was you going into the orchard,” she says

facts.fact: Amber 的指控清单：先是 Jordan、再 Sydney、现在 Brooke——认定 Max 是连环杀手。
facts.anchor: First Jordan. Then Sydney. And now Brooke.

facts.fact: Amber 的真痛点：Fairhope 长大的黑人女孩寥寥无几——Brooke 是第一个交她的朋友、带她进 Reds，是她活过这座小镇的原因。
facts.anchor: She’s the reason I survived growing up in this fucking town.

facts.fact: Max 反将一军：Amber 拿到母亲档案照与逮捕记录——逮捕警员是她哥哥 Andre，把机密信息交给未成年是重罪。
facts.anchor: I know you were the one who got my mom’s mug shot and arrest records.

facts.fact: Amber 载她去警局逼她自首——Max 拒绝、抢方向盘，车险些撞树才停下。
facts.anchor: I’m driving you to the station so you can turn yourself in.

facts.fact: 散心变惊魂——她回到 B&B 时比出发前更紧绷。
facts.anchor: I’m heading back more wound up than before.

facts.fact: 上台前她对着镜子穿上「Max Usher 的盔甲」——作家身份是她的战袍。
facts.anchor: put on my Max Usher armor.

facts.fact: Jalen 到场（如今是 Portland 理财经理，买了 Misty 卖的湖畔房）——Sienna 想撮合，Max 岔开。
facts.anchor: It’s so good to see you.

facts.fact: 朗读会全场爆满、半个镇都来了——唯独 Reds 全员缺席（抵制）。
facts.anchor: The only people noticeably absent are the Fairhope Reds.

facts.fact: Sienna 的临场鼓励：想逃我不拦，但别因为害怕错过美好——找一张友善的脸，只读给那个人听。
facts.anchor: Anything worth doing is always a little scary.

facts.fact: Milo 靠在门框上——一个眨眼就是她需要的全部勇气。
facts.anchor: Milo catches my eye and gives me a little wink, as if to say, You’ve got this.

facts.fact: 她开口朗读的正是自己小说的尾声——虚构的结局与现实的连环案在同一房间对望。
